DARV.talk.THE_QUEEN_CHARACTER_QUEEN_CHAR: A rare guest! Want to see my collection?
Could it be... a fellow collector? Hahaha, I'm in a good mood today, pick whatever you want!
Back again? I brought some new pieces today. Come take a look!
When will you show me your collection?
Not finished yet. There's one more item, at the top of the Spire.

You want the Architect's soul? That's no small thing.
But I do have a little grudge with him too, so I'll help you once for free!
NEOW.talk.THE_QUEEN_CHARACTER_QUEEN_CHAR: What... kind of... commotion... are you making...
What? Not happy to see me?
So this is what it feels like... to be awakened...
Next time... I won't... do it again...
If you don't like it, you don't have to wake me.
NONUPEIPE.talk.THE_QUEEN_CHARACTER_QUEEN:
This room is too bright. Not my style.
The decor should be replaced with amethyst... and...
Hey! Who are you to point fingers in here?
My apologies... I only thought your room could be even prettier.
You again... lady with poor taste... take this and go.

Why always in such a hurry to leave?
Surely you have time for one cup of tea.
The tea is good. I'm leaving.
OROBAS.talk.THE_QUEEN_CHARACTER_QUEEN_CH: Power of darkness! So scary! No violence allowed!
Embodiment of darkness! If you promise no killing, I'll give you a gift!
Why? They'll live perfectly well in my collection.
This is for you! Use this! Don't use darkness anymore!
PAEL.talk.THE_QUEEN_CHARACTER_QUEEN_CHAR: [thinky_dots]Take whatever you want. I'm going to sleep.[/thinky_dots]

[thinky_dots]What's it like, being obsessed with collecting?
I only like sleeping.[/thinky_dots]
...Feels like nothing. If I get bored, I'll find something else.
This sleeping thing you mentioned... I might try it when I have time.
[thinky_dots]You want my flesh? I don't really mind...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.THE_QUEEN_CHARACTER_QUEEN_CHAR: So the noise I hear in my castle every day... is you...
[b]What! You want me to quiet down? Can't do that![/b]
Whatever. Some screams are quite pleasant.
[b]Hahaha! That's the spirit! Take this, let's fight together!![/b]
[b]How do those gems even hurt people! Give them to me! I'll sharpen them for you!!![/b]
I refuse. I don't enjoy such barbaric fights.
[i][font_size=22]After taking the weapon, the Queen quickly left...[/font_size][/i]
TEZCATARA.talk.THE_QUEEN_CHARACTER_QUEEN: Oh my, why are you here too?
Just picking up a few things for my exhibition.
I didn't expect even you could be hurt! Let me treat you.
Try my [jitter][b]dessert[/b][/jitter]. I didn't make it in your likeness, but it tastes great!
Very nice. I'll take one to decorate my exhibition.
VAKUU.talk.THE_QUEEN_CHARACTER_QUEEN_CHA: A marketplace? I have thousands of jewels. What could I buy from you?
Heeheehee, I don't want jewels... what I want is souls.
Souls? I have thousands of those too. Name your price.
You're back again. What kind of souls did you bring this time?

Always trading other people's souls—hardly fair, is it?
Why not sign a contract with your own soul?
In that case, how about a more valuable soul? Wait until I take the Architect's head.

[sine][font_size=30]Hahahahaha![/font_size][/sine]
Very well, I accept this deal.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.THE_QUEEN_CHARACTER_Q: My exhibition still lacks one final piece.
You returned again. Still don't know when to stop?
Why? That old woman will wake me again.
Remember this well: no matter how many times you come, there is only one ending for you.
...I'll remember. So when I claim you, I'll savor the weight of this exhibit.
I'm afraid your display stand cannot bear my weight.
Only one way to find out.
